section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces 'The Present Study', which aims to investigate the independent contributions of intelligence and creativity (specifically divergent thinking ability) to humor production ability. The study will also differentiate between fluid (Gf) and crystallized (Gc) intelligence, expecting crystallized intelligence to be more relevant for humor production, particularly verbal intelligence.
